question_text:
10.  In context to service in transportation through railways, the company is
analyzing a relationship between volume of business on one axis with respect
to time on another axis. As per Product Life Cycle (PLC), which stage this
service is passing through:
(A)
Introduction
(B)
Maturity
(C)
Growth
(D)  Decline
